selection_rationale: LogisticRegression achieved superior balance of ROC-AUC (0.6974), PR-AUC (0.1457), and transparent feature-level odds ratio interpretability for sales action guidance.

raw_model.name: LogisticRegression (Balanced)
raw_model.explanation: Raw balanced class weighting artificially shifts the intercept and mean predicted probability to ~0.4077, yielding a test Brier score of 0.2136 (substantially higher than the naive baseline of 0.068). This raw score represents relative propensity for ranking, not true calibrated event probabilities.
